result.description: A fictional 27-inch desktop monitor built for mixed-use office and home entertainment setups, emphasizing smooth motion, vivid color, and flexible ergonomics rather than workstation graphics or storage hardware. The Orbit 960 features a 2560 x 1440 IPS panel, 165Hz refresh rate, 1ms response tuning, adaptive sync support, and a fully adjustable stand with tilt, swivel, pivot, and height adjustment. Connectivity includes DisplayPort, dual HDMI inputs, and a USB hub for peripherals. It is positioned as a general-purpose display for productivity, casual gaming, and streaming.
result.title: LumaNest Orbit 960 27in 165Hz Monitor
